newsitem.title: USA: San Francisco area home sales down in Nov - report.
newsitem.headline: San Francisco area home sales down in Nov - report.

text.p: Home sales in the San Francisco Bay area dropped nearly 14 percent in November from the previous month, but sales rose slightly from year-ago figures, according to a report released on Monday.

A total of 4,425 resale houses were sold in the nine-county San Francisco Bay area in November, down 13.7 percent from 5,125 for October but up 3.9 percent from 4,257 for November a year ago, DataQuick Information Systems said.
A decline in sales from October to November is normal for the season, the report said. Home sales have increased on a year-over-year basis for 15 of the last 16 months, it said.

Last month's median home price was $229,000, down 0.9 percent from October's $231,000 and up 0.9 percent from $227,000 from November a year ago. The October-to-November price decline is normal for the season, DataQuick said.
There has been a year-over-year increase in median sales price every month this year, DataQuick, which monitors real estate purchasing and financing nationwide, said.
